records.title: Audit and repair every module of shiftplan against its docstring contract 1
records.summary: Read every module in shiftplan and every shipped test. For each module, extract the behaviour its docstring promises and compare it line-by-line with the implementation. Find and fix every defect: wrong boundary semantics, state leaking between calls, caching that answers a question not asked, arithmetic that loses exactness, and error handling that turns failure into quiet success. Then perform the refactor: add shiftplan/strategy.py with Strategy (abstract rank) and GreedyCheapest, change assign_shifts to accept strategy=None meaning GreedyCheapest(), pass only skill-holding workers to rank, walk the ranked list skipping booked workers, and export Strategy and GreedyCheapest from shiftplan/__init__.py while keeping every existing export importable. Leave tests/test_visible.py byte-for-byte unchanged and ensure it passes.
